integrity: The complete 70-facet complex is embedded. Integral H1 is reconstructed by unimodular reduction; a primitive cocycle is checked on every facial relation; every graph triangle and the natural cyclic/dihedral symmetry actions are exhausted exactly.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to one labelled fourteen-vertex triangulation and simple cycles measured by edge count. The 1996 originating paper was bibliographically verified but its full body was not retrievable during this check.
title: Seventy coherently oriented triangular systoles in the fourteen-vertex \(S^4\times S^1\)
